description: Unit tests for Orleans' PooledBuffer implementation, covering large buffer handling, slicing, serialization, and enumerator correctness.

classes.name: PooledBufferTests
classes.description: Contains multiple unit tests to verify behavior and correctness of Orleans' PooledBuffer implementation, including size handling, slicing, serialization, and enumerator logic.

methods.name: LargeBufferRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests writing and reading a large buffer, verifying data integrity after slicing and copying.

methods.name: LargeBufferRoundTrip_Single
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of a large buffer as a standalone object.

methods.name: LargeBufferRoundTrip_ReaderWriter
methods.description: Tests the combined reading and writing via the Writer and Reader abstractions on large buffer data.

methods.name: PooledBuffer_WriteTwice
methods.description: Regression test to ensure serializing the same object twice does not cause issues, verifying pool behavior.

methods.name: PooledBuffer_SerializerRoundTrip
methods.description: Verifies that a PooledBuffer can be serialized and deserialized correctly multiple times.

methods.name: PooledBuffer_SerializerRoundTrip_Embedded
methods.description: Tests serialization/deserialization of a struct embedding a PooledBuffer, checking data integrity.

methods.name: BuildRandom
methods.description: Static method creating a LargeObject with random Guid values for testing.

methods.name: PooledBuffer_SliceEnumerators_OffsetCrossSegment_Correctness
methods.description: Ensures enumerators correctly handle slices crossing segment boundaries, verifying offset math and data correctness.

methods.name: PooledBuffer_SliceEnumerators_OffsetAfterFirstSegment_CoversPositionGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Verifies that enumerators work correctly when slice starts after the first segment, ensuring correctness in offset math.
